intro: Gyno Knott Drops is an ayurvedic topical blend crafted for targeted chest‑area massage to support firmness, circulation, and comfort. With consistent use alongside workouts and a balanced lifestyle, the formula helps relax tight tissue and improves skin feel around the chest. The non‑greasy texture absorbs quickly, making it easy to use day or night; results vary by routine and individual factors. This is a cosmetic/ayurvedic topical product and not a treatment for medical conditions.

li: Ayurvedic topical drops designed to support chest area firming and comfort during regular massage.
Helps ease the feel of deep muscle knots/lumps and promotes healthy local circulation.
Lightweight, fast‑absorbing, non‑sticky formula suitable for daily application.
Dropper pack allows precise, hygienic dosing for targeted areas.
Complements exercise and dietary routine focused on body shaping and wellness.
Apply 3–5 drops to clean, dry skin on the chest; massage in circular and upward strokes for 5–10 minutes.
Use 1–2 times daily for at least 8–12 weeks; pair with exercise and a balanced diet.
Patch test on inner arm 24 hours before first use.
1 x Gyno Knott Drops, 20 ml dropper bottle
Adults looking for ayurvedic topical support for chest massage, firmness, and tissue comfort.
External use only; avoid nipples, broken or irritated skin, and eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs.
Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. Results depend on massage and routine.
